gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve a list of local incoming phone numbers associated with my Twilio account, so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of local phone numbers, each with details such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to create a new local incoming phone number for my Twilio account, so that I can receive calls and messages on it.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the new phone number, including its SID, phone number, and any relevant metadata.
